summary.what_it_does: This is the blog for Wren AI, a conversational business intelligence product that turns plain-language questions into SQL run against the user's own database. The posts describe how it retrieves business context, writes and validates SQL, and returns results with the SQL and visuals behind them. Topics include a context layer and MDL semantic model, MCP connections to Claude, a ChatGPT app integration, row- and column-level security enforced in Wren Engine, and Git Sync for moving projects into Wren Cloud as YAML and Markdown files. The page is a post index, so it does not itself document pricing or full feature lists.
notable: Connects to 20+ databases through one MCP connection, per the Claude dashboards post
Row-level and column-level security applied at query time in Wren Engine
Git Sync stores the semantic model as plain YAML and Markdown in a git repo the user owns
Listed in the awesome-ai-agents directory under Links: Blog
caveats: Page is a blog index; product pricing and full feature details are not stated here
Some posts describe Wren AI Cloud, implying cloud-hosted features beyond the open-source project
